entities.name: Conservative Party of South Africa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Conservative party (formed in 1982 by former members of the national party; seeks the establishment of a separate afrikaner state as part of a south african confederation; merged in 2003 with the freedom front to form the freedom front plus) Headquartered in Cape Town. Founded 1982. Dissolved 2004.
